title: Estimating the atmospheric aerosol number size distribution using deep learning
content:
Environ. Sci.: Atmos., 2025, 5,367-377
DOI: 10.1039/D4EA00127C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yusheng Wu, Martha Arbayani Zaidan, Runlong Cai, Jonathan Duplissy, Magdalena Okuljar, Katrianne Lehtipalo, Tuukka Petäjä, Juha Kangasluoma
This article explores deep learning models to estimate the aerosol number size distribution using trace gas concentrations and meteorological data, addressing the limitations of costly and maintenance-intensive direct measurements.
